items.source: use of PathMatcher and UrlPathHelper is deprecated for use at runtime in web modules in favor of parsed patterns with PathPatternParser.
items.translation: 使用 PathMatcher 和 UrlPathHelper 已弃用，在 Web 模块中运行时建议使用 PathPatternParser 解析的模式。

items.source: Configure factory to create a custom RequestMappingHandlerMapping.
items.translation: 配置工厂以创建自定义的RequestMappingHandlerMapping。

items.source: This builder creates the minimum infrastructure required by the DispatcherServlet to serve requests with annotated controllers and also provides methods for customization. The resulting configuration and customization options are equivalent to using MVC Java config except using builder style methods.
items.translation: 此构建器创建由 `DispatcherServlet` 服务带有注解的控制器所需的最低基础设施，同时也提供自定义方法。生成的配置和自定义选项与使用 MVC Java 配置等效，只是采用构建器风格的方法。

items.source: Normally @ControllerAdvice are auto-detected as long as they're declared as Spring beans. However since the standalone setup does not load any Spring config, they need to be registered explicitly here instead much like controllers.
items.translation: 通常情况下，只要将 `@ControllerAdvice` 声明为 Spring Bean，它们就会被自动检测。然而，由于独立设置不会加载任何 Spring 配置，因此需要像控制器一样在此处显式注册它们。

items.source: Provide a custom Validator instead of the one created by default. The default implementation used, assuming JSR-303 is on the classpath, is LocalValidatorFactoryBean.
items.translation: 提供自定义的 Validator，而不是使用默认创建的实例。 假设 JSR-303 在类路径中，默认使用的实现是 LocalValidatorFactoryBean。

items.source: Set up view resolution with the given ViewResolvers. If not set, an InternalResourceViewResolver is used by default.
items.translation: 使用给定的 ViewResolvers 设置视图解析。如果未设置，则默认使用 InternalResourceViewResolver。

items.source: This method could be used from a subclass to register additional Spring MVC infrastructure such as additional HandlerMapping, HandlerAdapter, and others.
items.translation: 此方法可用于子类注册额外的 Spring MVC 基础设施，例如额外的 `HandlerMapping`、`HandlerAdapter` 等。

items.source: Set the ApiVersionStrategy to use when mapping requests.
items.translation: 设置用于映射请求的ApiVersionStrategy。

items.source: Sets up a single ViewResolver that always returns the provided view instance.
items.translation: 配置一个单例的ViewResolver，该解析器始终返回提供的视图实例。

items.source: Provide a custom Validator instead of the one created by default.
items.translation: 提供自定义的Validator，而不是使用默认创建的实例。

items.source: Provide a conversion service with custom formatters and converters. If not set, a DefaultFormattingConversionService is used by default.
items.translation: 提供带有自定义格式器和转换器的转换服务。如果未设置，默认使用DefaultFormattingConversionService。

items.source: Sets up a single ViewResolver that always returns the provided view instance. This is a convenient shortcut if you need to use one View instance only -- for example, rendering generated content (JSON, XML, Atom).
items.translation: 配置一个始终返回提供的视图实例的单个ViewResolver。如果您只需要使用一个视图实例（例如，渲染生成的内容（JSON、XML、Atom）），这是一个方便的快捷方式。

items.source: Provide a LocaleResolver instance. If not provided, the default one used is AcceptHeaderLocaleResolver.
items.translation: 提供一个 LocaleResolver 实例。 如果未提供，则使用默认的 AcceptHeaderLocaleResolver。

items.source: Set if ";" (semicolon) content should be stripped from the request URI. The value, if provided, is in turn set on UrlPathHelper.setRemoveSemicolonContent(boolean).
items.translation: 设置是否应从请求 URI 中剥离 ";" (分号) 内容。如果提供了该值，则将其设置到 UrlPathHelper.setRemoveSemicolonContent(boolean)。

items.source: In a standalone setup there is no support for placeholder values embedded in request mappings. This method allows manually provided placeholder values so they can be resolved. Alternatively consider creating a test that initializes a WebApplicationContext.
items.translation: 在独立设置中，不支持请求映射中嵌入的占位符值。此方法允许手动提供占位符值以便解析。或者，可以考虑创建一个初始化WebApplicationContext的测试。

items.source: Provide a custom FlashMapManager instance. If not provided, SessionFlashMapManager is used by default.
items.translation: 提供自定义的 FlashMapManager 实例。 如果未提供，默认使用 `SessionFlashMapManager`。

items.source: Add interceptors mapped to all incoming requests.
items.translation: 为所有传入请求添加拦截器。

items.source: Add interceptors mapped to a set of path patterns.
items.translation: 添加映射到一组路径模式的拦截器。

items.source: Set a ContentNegotiationManager.
items.translation: 设置一个 ContentNegotiationManager。

items.source: Provide custom resolvers for controller method arguments.
items.translation: 为控制器方法参数提供自定义解析器。

items.source: Provide custom handlers for controller method return values.
items.translation: 为控制器方法的返回值提供自定义处理器。

items.source: Set the HandlerExceptionResolver types to use as a list.
items.translation: 将要使用的 HandlerExceptionResolver 类型设置为列表。

items.source: Set the HandlerExceptionResolver types to use as an array.
items.translation: 将要使用的 HandlerExceptionResolver 类型设置为数组。

items.source:
Specify the timeout value for async execution. In Spring MVC Test, this
value is used to determine how to long to wait for async execution to
complete so that a test can verify the results synchronously.
items.translation: 指定异步执行的超时值。在 Spring MVC Test 中，该值用于确定等待异步执行完成的时间长度，以便测试能够同步验证结果。

items.source: initWebAppContext in class AbstractMockMvcBuilder<StandaloneMockMvcBuilder>
items.translation: initWebAppContext 类 AbstractMockMvcBuilder<StandaloneMockMvcBuilder>

items.source: servletContext - the ServletContext
items.translation: servletContext - ServletContext

items.source: a map with additional MVC infrastructure object instances
items.translation: 包含额外 MVC 基础设施对象实例的映射

items.source: To configure view resolution, either select a "fixed" view to use for every request performed (see setSingleView(View)) or provide a list of ViewResolvers (see setViewResolvers(ViewResolver...)).
items.translation: 要配置视图解析，可以选择一个用于每个请求的“固定”视图（参见setSingleView(View)），或者提供一个ViewResolver列表（参见setViewResolvers(ViewResolver...)）。

items.source: By default, this is a default instance of PathPatternParser.
items.translation: 默认情况下，这是一个PathPatternParser类的默认实例。

items.source: A method to obtain the WebApplicationContext to be passed to the DispatcherServlet. Invoked from AbstractMockMvcBuilder.build() before the MockMvc instance is created.
items.translation: 获取要传递给 `DispatcherServlet` 的 `WebApplicationContext` 的方法。在创建 `MockMvc` 实例之前，由 AbstractMockMvcBuilder.build() 调用。

items.source: Register one or more ControllerAdvice instances to be used in tests (specified Class will be turned into instance).
items.translation: 注册一个或多个将在测试中使用的ControllerAdvice实例（指定的Class将被转换为实例）。

items.source: Description copied from class: AbstractMockMvcBuilder
items.translation: 描述从类复制：AbstractMockMvcBuilder

items.source: A method to obtain the WebApplicationContext to be passed to the DispatcherServlet.
items.translation: 一种用于获取要传递给 `DispatcherServlet` 的 `WebApplicationContext` 的方法。

items.source: Configure the parser to use for PathPatterns.
items.translation: 配置用于 PathPatterns 的解析器。

items.source: Set up view resolution with the given ViewResolvers.
items.translation: 使用给定的 ViewResolvers 配置视图解析器。

items.translation: 受保护的构造函数。

items.source:
In a standalone setup there is no support for placeholder values embedded in
request mappings.
items.translation: 在独立部署中，不支持请求映射中嵌入的占位符值。

items.source: Specify the timeout value for async execution.
items.translation: 指定异步执行的超时值。

items.source: Provide a conversion service with custom formatters and converters.
items.translation: 提供带有自定义格式器和转换器的转换服务。

items.source: Provide a custom FlashMapManager instance.
items.translation: 提供自定义的 FlashMapManager 实例。

items.source: Provide a LocaleResolver instance.
items.translation: 提供一个 LocaleResolver 实例。

items.source:
Set the message converters to use in argument resolvers and in return value
handlers, which support reading and/or writing to the body of the request
and response.
items.translation: 在参数解析器和返回值处理器中设置要使用的消息转换器，以支持读取和/或写入请求和响应的主体。

items.source: Protected constructor. Not intended for direct instantiation.
items.translation: 受保护的构造函数。不打算直接实例化。

items.source:
Set the message converters to use in argument resolvers and in return value
handlers, which support reading and/or writing to the body of the request
and response. If no message converters are added to the list, a default
list of converters is added instead.
items.translation: 在参数解析器和返回值处理器中设置要使用的消息转换器，以支持读取和/或写入请求和响应的主体。如果未向列表中添加任何消息转换器，则会添加一个默认的转换器列表。

items.source: timeout - the timeout value in milliseconds
items.translation: timeout - 以毫秒为单位的超时值

items.source: parser - the parser to use
items.translation: parser - 要使用的解析器

items.translation: factory - 工厂
